text:
Maya: FYI found CVE-2026-XXXX in nginx-ingress controller (path traversal). vendor released 1.8.3 patch. Need rollout plan for prod clusters. Also got a cert-manager advisory about ACME HTTP challenge handling and KMS rotation implications.
Jon: Can you paste the link and CVSS? We need to know if there's exploit in default config.
Maya: Link: https://security.nginx.org/CVE-2026-XXXX
Maya: CVSS 7.5, exploitability medium. Affects ingress controller image <1.8.3 when proxy protocol enabled.
Rachel: For prod, I'd prefer canary upgrade across node pools. Drain, upgrade helm chart, watch 5m. If errors, rollback.
Sam: Reminder: Dedicated clusters have nodepools managed by infra team; Private clusters need on-prem operator coordination. @Jon who owns Dedicated patches?
Jon: Eng-infra handles dedicated pools. I'll schedule a maintenance window tonight 23:00 UTC. Can we confirm no config changes required besides image tag?
Maya: No config changes for nginx, but cert-manager needs KMS key rotation after patch because cert issuing flow touches KMS when nonce stored.
Kevin: For model-serving endpoints we have SR on TLS termination. If cert-manager rotation requires key roll, we may need short downtime for model endpoints behind LB.
Rachel: Do we have an automated playbook? I can run this checklist: 1) run kube-bench? 2) helm upgrade --reuse-values 3) watch pods 4) verify ingress rules.
Maya: Quick playbook snippet:
```bash
kubectl -n ingress get deploy nginx-ingress -o yaml
helm upgrade nginx-ingress ingress/nginx --namespace ingress --set image.tag=1.8.3 --reuse-values
kubectl -n ingress rollout status deploy/nginx-ingress
```
Jon: Also remember kubelet CVE-2026-YYYY that popped up in node scans — requires kubelet restart, doesn't need full node replacement. We'll coordinate kernel-safe restart window.
Sam: @Maya can you confirm cert-manager version and KMS provider? We need to open a support ticket with KMS if HSM re-wrap needed.
Maya: cert-manager 1.14.0. KMS is cloud-kms (GCP) for hosted, Vault in private clusters. For Vault we'll need operator to rewrap via consul.
Kevin: For Vault clusters — schedule of rolling restarts must ensure model-hosting pods with local caches are warmed after restart.
DeployBot: Automated scan results: https://ci.redwood/snyk/scan/789 - shows nginx-ingress <1.8.3 and kubelet packages flagged. (scan id 789)
Rachel: Ok plan: infra does dedicated tonight, private clusters early tomorrow, canary 10% traffic for 30m then 50% then 100%. Sam will open KMS ticket for Vault rewrap. Jon will prepare kubelet restart script. Maya to validate cert-manager post-patch.
Maya: I'll prepare PR with helm values and run smoke tests on staging. Will post status here.
Jon: I'll push the kubectl drain/restart script to eng-infra/tools and tag @Rachel for runbook.
Rachel: :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks all. I'll update incident board if anything flips.
